newsitem.title: USA: IndeNet says sells Mediatech for $25.8 mln.
newsitem.headline: IndeNet says sells Mediatech for $25.8 mln.

text.p: IndeNet Inc said Monday that it sold all of the stock of its Mediatech subsidiary to Digital Generation Systems Inc and that the transaction value is $25.8 million.

That figure comprises assumption of Mediatech debt, $5.9 million, and proceeds to IndeNet of: $13.9 million cash, $2.2 million in assumption of IndeNet debt, $2.2 million in a promissory note repayable quarterly at 9 percent over 4 years commencing October 1997, and $1.6 million of DGIT capital stock, a news release issued by IndeNet said.

The transaction improves IndeNet's cash position by about $13.2 million after costs and reduces IndeNet debt by $2.2 million reducing future interest expense by about $165,000 annually, the release said.

The transaction also results in a reduction of $11.4 million in acquisition costs carried on IndeNet's financial statements, reducing future amortization expense by about $1.8 million annually, the release said.
